fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Draftsman, Cartographer Mains Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Board (UPSSSC) has released the Mains Result for selection to the posts of Draftsman & Cartographer under the Advt No. : 11-Exam/2023. Applications for the UPSSSC Draftsman, Cartographer Recruitment 2023 were accepted from December 18, 2023, to January 08, 2024. The vacancy came in the year 2023 and it took almost one year nine month to conduct the written examination for the prescribed posts. The written examination was conducted on 16 November 2025. Candidates who had appeared in this examination can Download their UPSSSC Draftsman, Cartographer Mains Result 2026 from the direct link provided below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 18 December 2023
  • Last Date : 08 January 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 08 January 2024
  • Correction Last Date : 15 January 2024
  • Eligibility Result Available : 17 May 2025
  • Exam Date : 16 November 2025
  • Exam City Details : 07 November 2025
  • Admit Card : 12 November 2025
  • Answer Key : 17 November 2025
  • Mains Result : 07 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 25/-
  • PH (Dviyang) : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
